name: Qwen-AgentWorld 35B-A3B

lineage.how_derived: continual pre-training, SFT and RL (GSPO) into a language world model

purpose: A native language world model that simulates agentic environments: given an agent's action and the interaction history it predicts the next environment state with long chain-of-thought, covering MCP tool calling, search, terminal, software engineering, Android, web and OS in one model (card). It serves as a scalable, controllable simulator for training agents and as an agent foundation model after a 'LWM RL warm-up'.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file read: Apache License 2.0 with the vendor appendix, same md5 as the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B LICENSE.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE (qwen3_5_moe_text)
architecture.gguf_arch: qwen35moe (as the sibling Qwen3.5-35B-A3B; not verified for this repo)
architecture.attention: 10 x (3 x (Gated DeltaNet -> MoE) + 1 x (Gated Attention -> MoE)); 16 Q and 2 KV heads, head dim 256
architecture.why_this_design: Same layout as Qwen3.5-35B-A3B; card: environment modeling is trained in from continual pre-training onward ('native world model') rather than adapted onto a general LLM afterwards. No reasons given for the layer layout itself.

engine_support.notes: Same architecture as Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, which Tona already handles (qwen35moe); card recommends at least 128K context.

benchmarks.name: AgentWorldBench open-ended overall (5-dimension rubric mean, 0-100)
benchmarks.harness: vendor rubric benchmark; Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 47.73, GPT-5.4 58.25, Claude Opus 4.8 56.59, Qwen-AgentWorld-397B-A17B 58.71

strengths: Beats Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 8.7 points on the vendor benchmark at the same size
Same footprint and engine path as the general Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
weaknesses: Not a worker: it predicts what an environment would answer, it does not carry out tasks
best_for: Simulating tool and environment responses for agent training, testing and fictional-world construction
avoid_for: coding, chat or research work for end users
soft.maturity: Alibaba Qwen; technical report arXiv 2606.24597 (not read).

tona_fit.reason: Purpose mismatch for Tona users: it is an environment simulator for training agents, not a model that does their coding, research or chat. Quality, Apache-2.0 license (text read) and hardware fit are fine; revisit if Tona adds agent-training or tool-simulation features.
blockers: purpose: environment simulator, not a worker

sources.note: model card, config.json and LICENSE read

open_questions: Whether the agent-foundation warm-up gives a useful general agent model (card claims transfer to 7 benchmarks)
